median_convention: true median: mean of the two middle order statistics for even counts (src.aggregation.true_median); torch.median (lower median) is not used

privacy.accounting_note: RDP Poisson-sampling estimate. Routed client selection and the data-dependent robust filter are not covered by a formal proof; report this value as an estimated privacy budget.
privacy.mechanism: central Gaussian noise added to the clipped, weight-capped aggregate released after robust filtering; server momentum is post-processing
privacy.epsilon_label: diagnostic RDP estimate under a Poisson-sampling assumption

missing_update_handling.terminology: surrogate imputation: a coordinate-wise true median of received updates substitutes for a missing update; no information about the missing client's private data is recovered
